parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT
        $1::text AS raw_query,
        LOWER($1::text) AS lower_query,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER($1::text), '[-\s]', '', 'g') AS normalized_query
),
matched AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.sku,
        p.product_name,
        p.brand,
        p.category,
        p.product_family,
        p.lifecycle_status,
        p.commercial_status,

        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(p.product_id) = i.lower_query
                THEN 'EXACT_PRODUCT_ID'

            WHEN LOWER(p.sku) = i.lower_query
                THEN 'EXACT_SKU'

            WHEN LOWER(p.product_name) = i.lower_query
                THEN 'EXACT_PRODUCT_NAME'

            WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(p.sku), '[-\s]', '', 'g') = i.normalized_query
                THEN 'NORMALIZED_EXACT_SKU'

            WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(p.product_name), '[-\s]', '', 'g') = i.normalized_query
                THEN 'NORMALIZED_EXACT_NAME'

            WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(p.sku), '[-\s]', '', 'g')
                 LIKE '%' || i.normalized_query || '%'
                THEN 'NORMALIZED_PARTIAL_SKU'

            WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(p.product_name), '[-\s]', '', 'g')
                 LIKE '%' || i.normalized_query || '%'
                THEN 'NORMALIZED_PARTIAL_NAME'

            WHEN LOWER(p.sku) LIKE '%' || i.lower_query || '%'
              OR LOWER(p.product_name) LIKE '%' || i.lower_query || '%'
                THEN 'PARTIAL'
        END AS match_type,

        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(p.product_id) = i.lower_query THEN 0
            WHEN LOWER(p.sku) = i.lower_query THEN 1
            WHEN LOWER(p.product_name) = i.lower_query THEN 2
            WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(p.sku), '[-\s]', '', 'g') = i.normalized_query THEN 3
            WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(p.product_name), '[-\s]', '', 'g') = i.normalized_query THEN 4
            WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(p.sku), '[-\s]', '', 'g')
                 LIKE '%' || i.normalized_query || '%' THEN 5
            WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(p.product_name), '[-\s]', '', 'g')
                 LIKE '%' || i.normalized_query || '%' THEN 6
            WHEN LOWER(p.sku) LIKE '%' || i.lower_query || '%'
              OR LOWER(p.product_name) LIKE '%' || i.lower_query || '%' THEN 7
        END AS match_rank

    FROM products p
    CROSS JOIN input i
)
SELECT *
FROM matched
WHERE match_rank IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY match_rank ASC, product_name ASC;
